symptoms: Small, irregular water-soaked spots turning dark brown on leaf surfaces
Leaves turn yellow and drop severely, exposing fruit to sunscald
Raised warty blisters and scabs on pepper fruit walls
risk_factors: High temperatures (24-30°C) with rain, overhead watering, and high humidity
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed and resistant bell pepper cultivars (Bs1, Bs2, Bs3)
Drip irrigate to avoid wetting foliage
recommended_actions: Spray copper bactericide mixed with mancozeb for enhanced efficacy
